changes.text: 一种解释是，他宁可错过一次得手的机会，也不让对方事后找到说辞。至于他当时怎么权衡，本文所据材料只录了这一句，不作推测。

One reading of it is that he would rather let a chance of success slip by than give the other side a justification to use afterward. As for how he weighed the decision, the material used here gives only this line, and we do not speculate beyond it.
另一件事是让准备被看见。把备选供应商的评估、切换的时间和成本算清楚，摆在内部会议上，必要时让对方也知道；对方知道你真的走得开，条件才可能松动——也可能换不来松动，那就是要付的价。

The other thing is to let the preparation be seen. Work up the evaluation of alternative suppliers, and work out the timing and the cost of a switch; put it on the table in internal meetings, and where necessary let the other side see it too. When they know you can genuinely walk away, terms may loosen — or they may not, and that is the price to be paid.
本文只有一个史源，即《清史稿·左宗棠传》，成书于1928年，所述与当时档案未必一致。奏疏与对话（如「先之以議論」「師不以正」）是史书的记述，未必是逐字原话。英文版引号内的文字是作者对古文的译述。

This piece rests on a single source, the biography of Zuo Zongtang in the Draft History of the Qing, compiled in 1928; its account may not match the archives of the time. The memorial and the dialogue — such as "first take the matter up in negotiation" and "our army does not act from a position of right" — are the history's rendering and may not be verbatim. Quoted passages in English are the author's translations of the classical Chinese.
本文只据《清史稿·左宗棠传》一个史源，成书于1928年，所述与当时档案未必一致；奏疏与对话是史书记述，未必逐字。编年照原文年号，数字照录不核；「俄亦懾我兵威」与「和議成」是并置叙述，因果未经证实；崇厚约文与曾纪泽改约内容原文未载，不作补写。

This piece relies on a single source, the biography of Zuo Zongtang in the Draft History of the Qing, compiled in 1928, and its account may not match the archives of the time. The memorial and the dialogue are the history's renderings and may not be verbatim. Dates follow the original reign years; figures are copied as given and not checked. That "Russia was awed by our military might" and that "peace was concluded" appear side by side in the source, and the causal link is unproven. Chong Hou's treaty text and the substance of Zeng Jize's revision are not in the source and are not filled in here.
先看这份奏疏落在什么样的局面里。帕夏能役使回众，通使结援英、俄，购买兵械自备；英人暗中相助，想让他别立一国，用以屏障俄国。俄方则因回众屡扰其边境，出兵逐回，占了伊犁，还说要代取乌鲁木齐。

Start with the situation the memorial landed in. The Pasha could command the Muslim population, sent envoys to seek support from Britain and Russia, and bought weapons to arm his own forces. The British backed him quietly, hoping to see him set up a separate state that would stand as a shield against Russia. Russia, for its part, because Muslim raiders repeatedly harassed its border, sent troops to drive them out, seized Ili, and announced that it would go on to take Urumqi on China's behalf.

证据包没有记载传主卒年，“成书在传主身后”缺乏依据。已改为证据所载的“成书于1928年”，英文同步改为 "compiled in 1928"。
